emails.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 369.51 per unit, 60 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,257,706 over the term.
3. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 12-month agreement for 6,110 units, about EUR 2,257,706. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
